title: A cup with no bottom
translation: However brilliant he is in everything else, a man with no interest in love has something missing. He's like a beautiful jade cup with no bottom.

Getting soaked in dew and frost, wandering around without knowing where you'll end up, worried about your parents' warnings and what people will say, never a moment's peace, torn this way and that, and in the end mostly sleeping alone and lying awake all night: that's what makes it interesting.
Still, you shouldn't be a complete womaniser either. The ideal is for women to think you're not so easy to have.
original: よろづにいみじくとも、{色|いろ}{好|この}まざらむ{男|をのこ}は、いとさうざうしく、{玉|たま}の{巵|さかづき}の{底|そこ}なき{心地|ここち}ぞすべき。
{露霜|つゆしも}にしほたれて、{所|ところ}さだめず{惑|まど}ひ{歩|あり}き、{親|おや}のいさめ、{世|よ}のそしりをつつむに、{心|こころ}のいとまなく、{合|あ}ふさ{離|き}るさに{思|おも}ひ{乱|みだ}れ、さるは{独|ひと}り{寝|ね}がちに、まどろむ{夜|よ}なきこそ、をかしけれ。
さりとて{一向|ひたすら}たはれたる{方|かた}にはあらで、{女|をんな}にたやすからずおもはれむこそ、あらまほしかるべき{業|わざ}なれ。
literal: Even if splendid in every way, a man who does not love love is very dull, and must feel like a jade cup without a bottom.

Drenched by dew and frost, wandering astray without a fixed place, careful of his parents' warnings and the world's criticism, with no rest for his heart, distracted this way and that, and yet mostly sleeping alone, with no night of dozing off: that is what is interesting.
Even so, not being wholly given to dissipation, being thought by women not easy (to win): that is surely the desirable thing.

notes.text: {色|いろ}{好|この}む: 'to love love', to be a man of romance, not 'to be lecherous'. In the Heian ideal, a cultured man had to know love the way he knew poetry. Kenkō had become a Buddhist priest around 1313, and he wrote this as one.
From a Chinese classic, the Han Feizi: a priceless jade cup with no bottom cannot hold anything. Beautiful and useless.
Out at night to see a woman, wet with dew and frost: in Heian romance, the man visited at night and left before dawn. Wet sleeves are also a standard image for tears.
あふさきるさ: 'this way and that', 'torn between two ways'.

notes.quote: まどろむ夜なきこそ、をかしけれ
notes.text: こそ … けれ again. The sleepless, frustrated nights are exactly what makes love 'interesting'. Compare section 137, where unfulfilled love is the deepest kind.

notes.quote: 女にたやすからずおもはれむ
notes.text: 'To be thought of by women as not easy', not someone who is easy to have.
